moments.title: European Athletics Championships
moments.blurb: Birmingham is hosting the European Athletics Championships, a major track and field event, from August 10th to 16th.

angles.name: Live updates
angles.copy: It's the penultimate day of the European Athletics Championships in Birmingham! Who are you rooting for in today's finals?

angles.name: Mid-week highlight
angles.copy: World-class track and field action continues in Birmingham with the European Athletics Championships running until Sunday. Catch the best of Europe's athletes!

moments.title: The Weeknd at Wembley
moments.blurb: The Weeknd kicks off his five-night residency at Wembley Stadium tomorrow, August 14th, as part of his After Hours Til Dawn Stadium Tour.

angles.name: Anticipation
angles.copy: Get ready, London! The Weeknd brings his After Hours Til Dawn tour to Wembley Stadium starting tomorrow for five massive nights!

angles.name: Mega-tour
angles.copy: He's the most listened-to artist in the world for a reason! The Weeknd's Wembley residency is set to be epic. Who's got tickets?

moments.title: Ariana Grande O2 Residency
moments.blurb: Ariana Grande begins her highly anticipated ten-night 'Eternal Sunshine Tour' residency at London's O2 Arena on August 15th, marking her return to live performance.

angles.name: Pop comeback
angles.copy: The wait is over! Ariana Grande's 'Eternal Sunshine Tour' kicks off its ten-night O2 residency this Saturday. Get ready, Arianators!

angles.name: Big weekend
angles.copy: London is buzzing with Ariana Grande's return to the stage at The O2 this weekend. Who's managed to grab a ticket to this sold-out residency?

moments.title: Official UK Singles Chart Update
moments.blurb: Sam Fender & Olivia Dean hold the #1 spot for a phenomenal 20th week with 'Rein Me In,' while Ariana Grande has two new major entries in the Top 10.

angles.name: Chart domination
angles.copy: 20 weeks at #1! Sam Fender & Olivia Dean are unstoppable with 'Rein Me In'. Plus, big week for Ariana Grande with two new entries in the Top 10!

angles.name: New music
angles.copy: Huge congrats to Sam Fender & Olivia Dean for 20 weeks at Number 1! And welcome to the Top 10 for Ariana Grande's 'Petal' and 'Hate That I Made You Love Me'.

moments.title: Premier League Season Kicks Off
moments.blurb: The 2026/27 Premier League season begins on Friday, August 21st, with Arsenal vs Coventry City, followed by Hull City vs Manchester United on Saturday.

angles.name: Football's back
angles.copy: The Premier League returns in just over a week! Who's ready for the new season? Arsenal v Coventry kicks us off next Friday.

angles.name: Opening weekend
angles.copy: Mark your calendars! The 2026/27 Premier League season starts on August 21st. Hull City vs Manchester United is a Saturday lunchtime highlight.

moments.title: Community Shield & The Hundred Finals Day
moments.blurb: This Sunday, August 16th, sees Arsenal face Manchester City in the FA Community Shield, and also features The Hundred cricket Finals Day.

angles.name: Super Sunday
angles.copy: Sunday is shaping up to be a huge day for UK sport! It's the Community Shield: Arsenal vs Man City, AND The Hundred cricket Finals Day. What are you watching?

angles.name: Weekend sport
angles.copy: Who will lift the first football silverware of the season? Arsenal or Man City in the Community Shield this Sunday. Plus, the climax of The Hundred!

moments.title: Feargal Sharkey's Birthday
moments.blurb: Feargal Sharkey, iconic frontman of The Undertones and solo artist, turns 69 today.

angles.name: Teenage Kicks legend
angles.copy: Happy 69th Birthday to Feargal Sharkey! From The Undertones' 'Teenage Kicks' to his solo hits, what's your favourite Feargal track?

angles.name: Voice of a generation
angles.copy: Wishing a very Happy 69th Birthday to the distinctive voice of Feargal Sharkey! Still sounds incredible.

moments.title: Madonna's Birthday
moments.blurb: The Queen of Pop, Madonna, celebrates her 68th birthday on Saturday, August 15th.

angles.name: Pop royalty
angles.copy: Get ready to 'Vogue'! This Saturday, the one and only Madonna turns 68. What's your ultimate Madonna anthem?

angles.name: Material Girl
angles.copy: Celebrating the incomparable Madonna's 68th birthday this weekend! Her influence on music and pop culture is undeniable.

moments.title: John Deacon's Birthday
moments.blurb: Queen's legendary bassist, John Deacon, will celebrate his 75th birthday on Monday, August 19th.

angles.name: Queen's bassist
angles.copy: Next Monday, we're celebrating the 75th birthday of Queen's brilliant bassist, John Deacon! What's your favourite Queen bassline?

angles.name: Another one bites the dust
angles.copy: From 'Another One Bites the Dust' to 'I Want to Break Free', John Deacon's basslines are iconic. Happy 75th birthday for Monday!

moments.title: Wales Witnessed Partial Solar Eclipse
moments.blurb: Yesterday evening, large crowds gathered across Wales to witness a rare partial solar eclipse, with 90-96% of the sun obscured.

angles.name: Eclipse recap
angles.copy: Did you catch the incredible partial solar eclipse across Wales last night? Share your photos and experiences!

angles.name: Rare sight
angles.copy: From Cardiff to Rhossili Bay, thousands looked to the skies yesterday for the partial solar eclipse – the most visible since 1999!

moments.title: Travellers Return to Exeter Park
moments.blurb: An unauthorised encampment of Travellers has returned to Wonford Playing Fields in Exeter, just days after leaving, prompting Exeter City Council to plan 'further protective measures'.

angles.name: Local concern
angles.copy: Travellers have returned to Wonford Playing Fields. Exeter City Council says it's planning 'further protective measures'. Keep up to date with Radio Exe.

angles.name: Community impact
angles.copy: The return of an unauthorised encampment to Wonford Playing Fields has sparked renewed discussions on protective measures for Exeter's green spaces.

moments.title: Exeter Wildfire Contained
moments.blurb: Firefighters have contained a wildfire at Mincinglake Valley Park in Exeter, which destroyed around 50 acres of the beauty spot after raging on Tuesday.

angles.name: Firefighters praised
angles.copy: Huge thanks to all the fire crews who contained the Mincinglake Valley Park wildfire. A reminder of how dry conditions are in Exeter.

angles.name: Area recovery
angles.copy: Mincinglake Valley Park saw 50 acres destroyed by wildfire this week. Thoughts are with the local community and those working on recovery.

moments.title: Boomtown Festival Underway
moments.blurb: Boomtown Festival, known for its immersive storytelling and diverse music, is currently taking place near Winchester until August 16th.

angles.name: Festival vibes
angles.copy: Boomtown is in full swing near Winchester! Who's soaking up the unique atmosphere and incredible music this weekend?

angles.name: Chapter 13
angles.copy: Experience the magic of Boomtown! The festival continues until Sunday with its eclectic mix of music, art, and immersive theatre.

moments.title: UK Drought Conditions Worsen
moments.blurb: Drought conditions are intensifying across England, following the driest July on record, leading to water restrictions for over 25 million people.

angles.name: Water restrictions
angles.copy: With ongoing drought conditions and the driest July on record, over 25 million people in England are facing water restrictions. Please use water wisely.

angles.name: Summer dry spell
angles.copy: The dry summer continues across England, with concerns growing over water resources. Find out how you can help conserve water.
